## Selected agentic AI work

- Property Management Intake and Booking Agent (Lakeside Rentals) — Gemini-based, RAG-grounded.
- Roofing Intake and Qualification Governance Framework (Stonecastle Roofing) — n8n multi-agent orchestration with human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
- 24/7 Emergency-Response Dispatch Agent — after-hours triage and dispatch for service operators.
- Owner-Operator KPI and Reporting Agent (PointWake) — natural-language interface over CRM, booking, and accounting data.
- RLHF and frontier-model evaluation — Mercor Project Balboa and Handshake AI.
- Three capstone projects from UT Austin McCombs Post-Graduate GenAI program — includes a medical chatbot.
